articles.headline: Lockheed Martin Expands Advanced Munitions Manufacturing in Texas, Driving Thousands of New American Jobs
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin announced plans to create 6,000 jobs nationwide, including 2,000 in Grand Prairie, Texas, alongside a 200,000 square foot facility expansion to scale up munitions production.

articles.headline: Flock Safety Cuts 270 Jobs Amid Surveillance Backlash
articles.summary: Flock Safety reduced 18% of its workforce (270 positions) due to regulatory adjustments and policy shifts surrounding automated license plate reader camera networks.

articles.headline: HubSpot Cuts 660 Jobs in Restructuring Around AI Customer Outcomes
articles.summary: HubSpot CEO Yamini Rangan announced a corporate restructuring plan to reduce middle management layers and realign product development teams toward AI customer delivery, eliminating approximately 660 roles.

articles.headline: Bayer Commences $1B Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Campus Construction
articles.summary: Bayer broke ground on a $1 billion modular manufacturing campus in New Albany, Ohio, designed for targeted oncology and renal therapy production, creating approximately 600 jobs.

articles.headline: Workday Cuts 525 Jobs in Second Major Layoff Round
articles.summary: Workday executed a secondary workforce reduction round impacting 525 employees (roughly 2.5% of staff), concentrated heavily within software development and quality engineering divisions.

articles.headline: MasterBrand Cabinets Files WARN Notice for Kinston Facility
articles.source_name: WARN Tracker / NC Dept. of Commerce
articles.summary: MasterBrand Cabinets filed a state WARN Act notice disclosing mass layoffs impacting 391 manufacturing employees at its facility in Kinston, North Carolina.

articles.headline: Morgan Stanley Dallas Expansion Announces More Than 3,800 Jobs
articles.summary: Texas state economic development filings confirmed an enterprise campus expansion establishing a major financial services and IT hub in Dallas, creating more than 3,800 jobs.

articles.headline: Bristol Myers Cuts Another 265 Jobs Tied to New Jersey Headquarters
articles.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb disclosed a WARN Act notice extending its cost-reduction initiative, cutting 265 corporate positions in Mercer County, New Jersey.

articles.headline: Pirelli Announces $1.2B U.S. Manufacturing Expansion
articles.summary: Pirelli announced a multi-year $1.2 billion expansion to scale up automated and robotic tire production in Rome, Georgia, creating roughly 1,000 jobs.

articles.headline: Microsoft Cuts Hundreds More Jobs in Xbox Overhaul
articles.summary: Microsoft executed an additional wave of workforce reductions affecting approximately 650 positions across gaming hardware and studio development teams following its Activision Blizzard integration.

articles.headline: Toano Medical Product Manufacturer to Close Facility and Lay Off Staff
articles.summary: Avid Medical Inc. filed a WARN notice with Virginia state authorities announcing the complete closure of its production plant in Toano, Virginia, eliminating 419 roles.

articles.headline: Toys "R" Us Opens 120 Standalone Stores for Holiday Season
articles.summary: Toys "R" Us partnered with Go! Retail Group to launch 120 standalone storefronts nationwide ahead of the Q4 holiday retail surge.

articles.headline: Wonder Layoffs: 533 Cut in New Jersey WARN Filing
articles.summary: Wonder Group filed a New Jersey WARN Act notice covering 533 production and logistics positions as it consolidates facilities into a unified hub in Swedesboro.

articles.headline: Uber to Shed 10% of Workers as It Moves to Cut Costs
articles.summary: Uber announced a corporate restructuring plan trimming roughly 10% of non-driver corporate roles (approximately 3,300 positions) to optimize operational overhead.
